name: dev-director
description: Develop a raw video idea into a cinematic concept and shot list. Use when the user has a theme or rough idea but no finished prompt, and wants characters, environment, interactions, sequence and style defined before prompting. Runs a short interactive Q&A, then routes to dev-shot-grammar / dev-mise-en-scene / dev-shot-plan. Do NOT use when a fully-formed prompt is already given (h3-director), or for loading a genre (genre-orchestrator).
